recipes.projection: TwoGun mode: Proj is TwoGun's own DraftKings projection for the 333 players he projects (board updated Thu, Oct 29, 6:07 PM CT), used exactly as he publishes it; his game lines replace ESPN's where he has one. TwoGun's board is 66.9 hours older than the first kickoff (over 36), so every TwoGun figure is marked stale. The other 229 players keep the current projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage falls back to the DraftKings average points per game, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0; with no average it stays blank rather than zero.
recipes.ownership: TwoGun mode: Own% is TwoGun's projected ownership for a Milly Maker-size field for the 332 players he lists one for (ownership updated Thu Oct 29 7:33 AM CT); every other player keeps the current number: Own% is the average, by source weight, of the numbers Weekly findings file, Footballguys percent rostered and RotoWire projected roster % published for the DraftKings main slate; numbers for any other site or slate are never used. Stokastic DK cheat sheet is downloaded, stored and shown in its own column, but never averaged into Own% (weight 0). A number Adam types into the Own% cell replaces the published one for that player. A player with no published number is left blank: the app never estimates ownership, so game popularity exists only where a real number does.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)
